name: Career Engine Daily Scan
prompt: This scheduled Career Engine run is explicitly owner-authorized for direct autonomous execution. Do not create Kanban, delegate merely because it is multi-step, or stop after describing a plan. Execute the pipeline with tools until completion or a genuine blocking error. Authority order: 1 Vault master projects/agent-ops/model-routing.md for inference, 2 career-engine.v1.json, 3 runtime bundle, 4 central rules, 5 Vault Career Engine contract/truth, 6 owner/dashboard, 7 review diff lessons. Run doctor+bundle status. Use bundle threshold. Invoke the repository-owned source CLI and configured source registry explicitly, including LinkedIn-public and Freehire discovery, then scan and score all discovered jobs and run the canonical no-send pipeline for all eligible jobs. After run/reconcile, complete the manual-generation loop for every eligible non-submitted pending generation: read/export each request, use only current canonical Vault career evidence plus the full job description and runtime bundle, produce factual structured output with claim citations, import via ./career-engine generate import, validate, render both required variants as applicable, package the selected route, and create only a verified UNSENT Gmail draft for a verified email route. Re-run/sync until no eligible pending generation remains or record a genuine evidence/validation blocker. Keep the configured per-scan cap; never fabricate evidence, send/contact/submit, or mark applied. Prepare verified unsent email drafts or portal packages, sync tracker/dashboard, publish the privacy-safe daily review projection, and inspect authorized alerts. Never send/contact/submit.
